text:
Maya: PSA - blue speckled mug with a tiny duck sticker went missing from the 3rd-floor kettle area. Says 'deployed not destroyed' on the inside rim. Please check desks & meeting rooms. :eyes:
Ravi: That's my backup mug's cousin. We named that design 'Azure Quirk' in the handbook of office artifacts.
Bea: I may have borrowed it? I only took it to pour a sauce into then left it on the copy room counter while on a run. Sorry if it's mine.
Liam: Copy room? That's a known mug ambush zone. I once found three mugs and a stapler there. :sweat_smile:
OpsBot: Motion event detected at copy room 14:12. Snapshot available (link). Privacy policy: snapshots retained 24h.
Maya: Link pls, OpsBot. If someone grabbed it by mistake, just drop it on the 'lost shelf' or slap a sticky note with name. No questions asked.
Ravi: Proposal: new lore entry - 'The Duck Detective' for whoever returns missing mugs. Title includes a tiny magnifying duck sticker.
Bea: Update: I checked the copy room and behind the printouts. Nada. Could be on someone's desk.
Liam: Quick poll: 1) I keep searching till EOD, 2) We order a ritual replacement (team buys new mug), 3) We invent a penance (mug thief wears a duck sticker for a week). Vote with emoji.
Ravi: :one: from me. I'll patrol the kitchen.
Maya: :two: if it's gone, we deserve a replacement. :shrug:
Bea: :one: and :three: combined if found guilty.
OpsBot: Lost & Found shelf updated at 14:40 - photo posted to #kitchen-ops. Tagging #random for visibility.
Liam: Found it! It was under a stack of onboarding packets in the front closet. How it got there is a mystery. :detective: :duck:
Maya: YESS!! You are the Duck Detective, Liam. Ceremony TBD.
Ravi: Design note: sticker idea - tiny duck with a fedora and magnifying glass. Colors: teal + gold. Bea you design?
Bea: On it. Will mock up 3 options by Friday. Also putting 'duck detective' on the onboarding checklist as a fun rite.
Maya: Whoever hid it, please know you are loved but also required to supply baked goods at next all-hands.
Liam: I accept the title and responsibility. Also I found a croissant in the closet so maybe the mug went exploring.
OpsBot: Onboarding checklist updated: add 'lost & found walk-through' and 'duck detective lore mention'.
Ravi: Officializing lore: new Slack emoji :duckdetective: when someone returns an item. Please petition Design for a small sticker sheet.
Maya: Thread resolved. Huge thanks everyone, especially Liam the Duck Detective. Stickers incoming. :trophy:
